candidate_relations.reason: The histology shows nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium with mucin-containing goblet cells and slender fibrovascular cores — hallmarks of Schneiderian (exophytic/fungiform) papilloma, not a simple squamous cell papilloma. Squamous cell papilloma is a related but incompatible subtype lacking the goblet cell component and Schneiderian lineage that define the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Squamous cell papilloma is a distinct entity from Schneiderian papilloma; the reference specifies Schneiderian (sinonasal ectodermal) origin with goblet cells and nonkeratinizing epithelium, whereas squamous cell papilloma of the nasal vestibule arises from keratinizing squamous epithelium of the skin-lined vestibule and lacks goblet cells

case_quality_flags: Lesion located at nasal vestibule (skin-lined area) rather than classic sinonasal mucosa, but histology with goblet cells and nonkeratinizing epithelium confirms Schneiderian origin, consistent with exophytic Schneiderian papilloma extending to vestibule
